topic: 处理客户交付剩余工序
raw_input: 基于 ANL-2026-04-18-为了交付客户还有哪些工作没做 的结论，处理剩余客户交付工序：冻结精确交付基线、补跑客户 writer golden-path smoke、明确 unsigned demo/internal handoff vs signed external shipment、组装 customer handoff bundle、确认客户平台范围并补充缺失证明。
reasoning: The remaining work spans release baseline control, customer-facing validation, package/signing policy, handoff packaging, platform-scope confirmation, and hold/readiness references, so it was decomposed by the planner into seven bounded execution issues before implementation.
